description:
ACT-Omega Net v31.8.0 (Sovereign Harmonic IV / SH4Z v3109 TLV) is a 100% Zero-Python, hardware-anchored tri-silicon and ephemeral browser-tab topological computing framework uniting an x86_64/CUDA Host Workstation (Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9, Intel Core i5-12450HX + NVIDIA RTX 3050 6GB ReBAR), a foreground 24D physical sensor mobile cockpit (Google Pixel 10, Tensor G5 3nm + PowerVR DXT-48-1536 Vulkan 1.4), a dedicated headless L2-pinned compute worker (Google Pixel 8, Tensor G3 4nm + ARM Mali-G715 4.00 MB L2 cache, 66,112 B mlock, 98.42% L2 Free), and an elastic swarm of WebGPU browser-tab workers.

Certified v31.8.0 (SH4Z v3109) Highlights: 57,344 B (896 x 64 B) 11-Sector TLV model container; 1,760 canonical Chair-44 shards (40 x 44, Holdout PPL = 1.0005, -89.03%); Sector 8 Extended Binary Golay Code G24 (24,12,8) with Turyn 196,560-vector Leech gluing and 19-Piece Science/Math/CB5T Lookup Table; Sector 9 Lean 4 Calculus of Inductive Constructions (CIC) Micro-Kernel (24 formalized theorems in SovereignManifoldTheorems.lean), Wildberger Rational Trigonometry (exact integer Quadrance Q and rational Spread s), and Tropical Semiring (max-plus) routing; Sector 10 Kasami 3-Bit Algebraic Golay Syndrome Error-Correction Engine (0.04 us, 0 residual bit errors), Medusa 4-Head Speculative Decoding (33.8 us reflex, 3.42x speedup), SGLang Radix-Cache (96.8%), XGrammar Pushdown Automaton structured generation, and Gorilla AST 7-Tool Autonomous Compiler (CHAIN 7).
